# Yandex

Yandex is a Russian internet services provider offering search, email, navigation, and other web-based solutions, often referred to as “Russia’s Google”

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/yandex/.

## Actions

- **Generate detailed route** (read-only): Generate detailed route for driving, walking, or public transport.
- **Organization Search** (read-only): Find businesses and organizations by name, address, or tin.
- **Yandex Geocoder Reverse** (read-only): Perform reverse geocoding using yandex maps http geocoder api.
- **Yandex Tiles API** (read-only): Fetch individual map tile images by x/y coordinates and zoom level.
